_izoh: 8 reference formats (samples/<Format>.mp4) + matching samples 1-42. Evidence: temp/style_study/videos/f_*/ (overview_*.jpg, m_grid_*.jpg, transcript.json), temp/style_study/format_features.json (measured with scripts/formats.py). >=3 videos = pattern, fewer = observation. detect.rules are scored by scripts/formats.py; agent extras (costume, props, question_given, mic_or_headphones, interviewer_voice) come from looking at frames. Guide: docs/FORMATS.md.

talking_head.name: Talking head
talking_head.summary: One speaker to camera in one (studio) setup; graphics explain the points around the body, not on the face.

evidence: 0.6-4.8 glowing serif digits 1/2/3 orbit the seated speaker, '1' scales up to ~45% H (overview_01)
5.6-9.4 phone screen recordings fly in as tilted 2.5D cards and fill the frame (overview_01)
12.8 keyword pair 'reelsda / probnyy' on glass bars, glow, ~5% H at 50-65% y (m_grid_12.8)
measured: face 0.80, gaze_off 0.0, 3 setups (= inserted phone screens), 3.2 cuts/min, no full subtitles

matching_samples.evidence: seated, numbered list with thumbnails, 0 cuts (mosaic)
seated on bench, list + big number 18, 8.8 cuts/min
standing, glass right/wrong cards, 0 cuts in 95 s
seated + drawn graphic scenes
seated, phone UI cards
seated at desk, grid statistics, prop entrance
standing on campus, one setup + paper cards
standing, one location, 8.5 cuts/min
seated, locked camera, persistent bracket graphic, 0 cuts

talking_head.recognise: one person, eyes to the lens (gaze_off <= 0.2), face in most frames, 1-3 backgrounds, little voice-over.
talking_head.structure: hook claim or number (<=1.5 s) -> numbered points, each with one visual -> short summary -> CTA (spoken or follow card).

edit.cut_pattern: cuts only to remove silences/repeats; visual change comes from graphics and zoom punch every 2-4 s; calm 3-5 s stretches allowed.

captions.note: example uses keyword-only glass bars; samples A use lowercase lockups

edit.broll: rare; screen recordings / product shots as 2.5D cards rather than full cutaways
edit.sound: speech first; light SFX on graphic entrances (stronger + subtle rendered)
mistakes: graphics over the face
a label repeating the subtitle
constant zoom pulsing
no calm stretch for a long explanation

talking_head.group_reason: seated/static speaker with explainer graphics (A members s02 s05 s06 s09 s16 s25 s33 s42)

interview.name: Interview
interview.summary: Guest answers an off-camera host (podcast or street mic); the person looks past the lens; small sentence subtitles.

evidence: one locked shot, headphones + mic, 0 cuts in 54.9 s (contact)
one-line sentence subtitles, white ~2.4% H at 48-50% y, no word animation (m_grid_8.6)
brand watermark at ~75% y
measured: gaze_off 0.97, face 1.0, 2 setups

matching_samples.evidence: seated guest looking off-camera, B&W intro, office b-roll; gaze_off 0.43
street mic interview, question title at top; gaze_off 0.54
two people standing (two_face 0.89) but both face the lens (gaze_off 0.13): duo-to-camera interview; detector ranks talking_head first
graduate testimonials seated; two_face 0.43, gaze_off 0.49
seated guest in profile; gaze_off 1.0
two women seated conversation; two_face 0.41, gaze_off 0.65
dark studio, speaker looks off-camera (gaze_off 0.62) but kinetic edit (B2)

interview.recognise: person turned away from the lens (gaze_off >= 0.4) and/or two people in frame; mic/headphones; long answers.
interview.structure: strongest answer first (cold open) -> question as title -> answer -> second answer / proof -> name + CTA.

edit.cut_pattern: keep long calm answers (C median shot 8 s); cut repeats and the host's filler; b-roll only where the guest names something concrete.

captions.note: no word-by-word animation in the example

edit.broll: sparse, concrete nouns only; never during an emotional answer
edit.sound: room tone kept; music very low or none; SFX minimal (sfx off or subtle)
mistakes: kinetic word animation over a calm answer
graphics every 3 s
cutting the guest's pauses that carry emotion
covering the mic/face with a name tag

interview.group_reason: small captions, long calm answers, name tags (C members s04 s08 s10 s13 s30 s31 s32 s38)

kadr_rakursli.name: Kadr rakursli
kadr_rakursli.summary: Cinematic multi-angle: the same person in many shots/places (wide, back, aerial, close), often voice-over; giant condensed word + scattered small words.

evidence: 0.2-2.4 giant red condensed 'DARAXT' ~22% H (10-34% y) behind a wind turbine, small words spread across the width at 40% y appear one by one (m_grid_1.6)
3.8 'SAHRO' fades in on a new desert shot
4.6-6.0 motion-blurred running shot, words 'ko'kat u joyda / 2yil tursa' spread with big gaps ~4% H (m_grid_5.8)
6.2-8.0 same face ages (grey beard) in a static close-up
measured: 10 setups, 19.4 cuts/min (median shot 2.1 s), voice-over 58%, face height median 0.07 (wide shots)

matching_samples.evidence: same speaker in 7 park setups, 18.7 cuts/min
13 setups, walking shots, 22.7 cuts/min
13 setups, 22.2 cuts/min, film b-roll
11 setups, 27 cuts/min
13 setups, voice-over 62%, wide shots (face 0.05), 38 cuts/min
12 setups, on-camera speech (vo 0.0)
11 setups, 30 cuts/min (also syudjetli/obrazli traits)

kadr_rakursli.recognise: many different backgrounds (setups >= 5), frequent cuts, wide/back shots with small faces, often voice-over.
kadr_rakursli.structure: image-led: one strong word per shot; metaphor carried by locations; the speaker appears in a few anchor close-ups.

edit.cut_pattern: cut on phrases, shot median ~2 s (1.2-3.2), each sentence a new angle; hold the emotional close-up longer.

captions.mode: keyword titles + scattered small words, no full subtitle block
captions.note: giant word can sit behind the person/object (behind_person)

edit.broll: the footage IS the b-roll: many angles of the same subject; stock only for metaphors
edit.sound: music bed under voice-over is typical (agent cannot judge); whoosh on hard location changes
mistakes: full subtitles covering the cinematic image
graphics cards that fight the scenery
same angle twice in a row

kadr_rakursli.group_reason: kinetic creator edits with many walking/location shots (B2 s12 s14 s22 s23 s26 s27 s28)

syudjetli.name: Syudjetli
syudjetli.summary: Story / plot: staged scenes act out what is said (car, notebook, sticky notes, screenshots), the speaker is a character in his own story.

evidence: 0.2-2.6 'MEN ISHDAN' red condensed caps (~10% H) + white 'bo'shadim' stacked at the top while he walks to a car (overview_01)
2.8-5.0 'VA onlayn maktab' lockup builds word by word (m_grid_4.6)
6.8 '7K$' red number + 'pul topish kerak' on a brick-wall close-up
10.0 '"MAC" BILAN' over a Dutch-angle laptop shot (m_grid_10.4)
15.0-16.0 profile-activity cards stack up one per word; 16.4 grid of view-count screenshots
17.6-19.0 notebook page turns: 'KONTENT MARKETING' -> 'AUDITORIYA YIG'ISH + SOTUV' written by hand
measured: 16 setups, 24.8 cuts/min, voice-over 38%

matching_samples.evidence: staged visa story with an actress, B&W for setbacks, 20.9 cuts/min
brand story ad with actors and chat UI, 13.9 cuts/min
staged family/subway scenes + speaker, 15.2 cuts/min
skit: same actor as human (warm) and AI (blue)

syudjetli.recognise: many setups (>= 8), staged inserts with props or other actors, speaker sometimes absent while talking (voice-over 20-50%).
syudjetli.structure: setup (status quo) -> turning point -> problem with a number -> plan -> proof (screens, numbers) -> offer -> CTA.

edit.cut_pattern: one shot per sentence (median 2.3 s); match the action to the words (car on 'ishdan', laptop on 'MAC').

captions.mode: lockup titles carry the speech: red hero word + white small words, word by word; no extra subtitle block

edit.broll: staged own footage first; screenshots/proof as stacked cards
edit.sound: music + SFX on scene changes are typical (agent cannot judge)
mistakes: subtitles AND lockup titles at the same time (double text)
props that do not match the word
slow first scene

syudjetli.group_reason: story edits with staged scenes and kinetic lockups (s29 B1, s19/s11 D, s28 B2)

obrazli.name: Obrazli
obrazli.summary: Character / persona: the speaker plays a role (costume, theatre light), a metaphor carries the message; slow, dark, minimal text.

evidence: magician / joker character on a dark stage, spotlights, black frames between beats (contact 2.96-14.8)
28.8-31.8 card trick close-up; tiny light captions 'Nozik / harakatlar / natijasi' stepped, ~2.5% H at 70-78% y (m_grid_31.0)
32.0-35.0 single word per beat 'BU', 'HARAKATLAR', 'SHUNCHALIK' ~1.5% H at the top
62.1 'ko'rishga qiluvchi' top-left in negative space
measured: dark, voice-over 58%, 6 setups, 15.9 cuts/min but long holds (max 17.8 s)

matching_samples.evidence: the same actor plays an AI double, colour-coded blue vs warm
dark theatrical look, small captions (dark=true)

obrazli.recognise: costume / character or theatrical lighting (agent), dark frames, long voice-over passages.
obrazli.structure: mysterious opening -> reveal of the metaphor -> transfer to the real topic -> offer -> calm ending.

edit.cut_pattern: slow; long holds and black beats; cut on gestures, not on words.

captions.mode: tiny single words / short phrases in negative space, stepped

edit.broll: none; the performance is the picture
edit.sound: mood music and room tone (agent cannot judge)
mistakes: big kinetic captions
stickers/emoji
filling every pause

savol_javob.name: Savol javob
savol_javob.summary: Answer to a follower question: the question card stays on screen, one selfie take, no other graphics.

evidence: Instagram question sticker 'Qanaqa savollar bor? / Aka kursizni tekinga padarka qilaszmi?' at 5-10% y for the whole video (overview_01)
phone selfie, one take, 1.7 cuts/min, no subtitles
measured: top_card true, face height 0.36, gaze_off 0.0

matching_samples.evidence: question title at the top 'O'ZINGIZNI QANDAY HIS QILYAPSIZ?' (interviewer question, not a follower question)

savol_javob.recognise: persistent question card at the top (top_card) or the user gives the question; selfie framing; single take.
savol_javob.structure: question card from frame 0 -> direct answer in the first sentence -> reason / example -> advice -> CTA (ask more questions).

edit.cut_pattern: remove silences and repeats only; keep it one continuous take feeling.

captions.mode: optional small subtitles below the face; the question card is the main text

mistakes: hiding the question after the first seconds
heavy graphics that make it look less personal

savol_javob.group_reason: single speaker, calm, text-light (A defaults with fewer graphics)

tepa_past.name: Tepa-past
tepa_past.summary: Split screen: speakers on top, matching b-roll at the bottom, word-by-word captions in a black band between.

evidence: top 0-40%: two people at a desk with a laptop (m_grid_2.0)
40-46%: black band with word-by-word captions, active word white, others grey ~3% H
46-100%: b-roll that shows exactly what is said (burning car, cup, TikTok clips), cut every ~3 s while the top stays
measured: split_line 1.0, two_face 1.0, 15.7 cuts/min (bottom)

tepa_past.recognise: persistent horizontal seam in the middle (split_line >= 0.9) in finished videos; for raw footage: a conversation/talking head plus enough topic b-roll.
tepa_past.structure: story told by the speakers; every concrete noun gets a bottom clip; top never cuts away.

edit.cut_pattern: top: continuous; bottom: one clip per idea, 2-4 s.

captions.mode: karaoke band between the halves (active word white, rest grey)

edit.broll: mandatory and continuous (broll mode split, layout_morph in/out)
edit.sound: speech only from the top; b-roll muted
mistakes: b-roll that does not match the words
captions over the faces
empty bottom half

tepa_past.group_reason: conversation on top (C), continuous b-roll below

selfie round-video testimonials inside the edit

birinchi_yuzdan.recognise: very large face (face_height >= 0.4) looking into the lens, single take, no cuts.
